text: CR Beverage (China Resources Beverage (Holdings) Co., Ltd., HKEX 02460) describes itself as a core business unit under China Resources (Group) Co., Ltd., headquartered in Nanshan, Shenzhen, according to the company's own website.
short: CR Beverage is a core business unit of state-owned China Resources Group.
